report.explanation: Current evidence shows a healthy checkout path: gateway checkout span OK at 66ms, order logs 200/ok, payment error_rate 0.001 with p95 72ms and zero dependency timeouts or pool waiters. The order deployment (3.3.9, 603 min old, valid config) cannot by itself establish latency or failure. No observation supports any taxonomy cause, so no bounded candidate is substantiated; hand off for operator review.
